answer: The system resists sybil attacks by mapping transaction graphs to identify artificial clusters. When a central wallet acts like a nebula, dispersing small amounts to thousands of new accounts, a clear funding trail emerges. These nodes often move in a synchronized tide, showing tight co-spend patterns or timing correlations. By treating this inlet of activity as a single entity, the network discounts their collective attestations. This structural analysis ensures that one actor posing as a crowd cannot dilute the voting power of genuine participants.
